pkgmetadata.longdescription: stamp-suite implements the Simple Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (STAMP, RFC 8762) and its optional extensions (RFC 8972) for measuring packet loss and network delay. A single binary acts as either the Session-Sender or the Session-Reflector, selected by command-line flag.

use.flag: Build the localhost control-plane REST API (TLS via rustls) for runtime session, key and shutdown management of the reflector
Use kernel and NIC hardware timestamping (SO_TIMESTAMPING) instead of userspace clocks
Build the SNMP AgentX subagent and install the STAMP-SUITE-MIB
